description: This Java class defines the response for a 'ModifyPolicy' command in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encompasses static factory methods for creating instances based on different HTTP statuses, methods for deserializing from JSON, and overrides for equality, hashing, and string representation. The class manages information about the modified or created policy, its ID, and relevant headers.

classes.name: ModifyPolicyResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a 'ModifyPolicy' command, with methods for creation, JSON deserialization, and accessors for policy information.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a response object indicating a policy has been created, with overloads accepting either String or PolicyId for policy identification.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a response object indicating a policy has been modified, with overload accepting PolicyId.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a ModifyPolicyResponse instance.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this response.

methods.name: getPolicyCreated
methods.description: Returns Optional containing the created Policy if available.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the Policy as a JSON value if available, respecting the provided schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JSON pointer, indicating the resource path.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Builds the JSON payload for this response, including the policy ID and optionally the policy object.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response with updated DittoHeaders, depending on whether the policy has been created or modified.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on policy ID, created policy, and superclass properties.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on internal fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the response object.
